title: Too Narrow
text:
Too Narrow. The width from left to right where the bag attaches is only 7 inches. It's really too narrow. You cannot put in a full size paper or plastic dinner plate into the bag straight in left to right. (If you turn the plate as you're starting at the top of the bag you can get it into the bag, of course.)

If you do not mind the narrow size, and if it holds up (some have reported their have not held up), this bag holder will work well for you.
